messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] trouble with conditional statements
parts:
Sorry about that --- the new error messages haven't quite
percolated through to RStan yet --- it's not telling you
what the error is!

Here's what it will say soon:

-----------------------------------
~/cmdstan(develop)$ mk ~/temp2/berman

--- Translating Stan model to C++ code ---
bin/stanc /Users/carp/temp2/berman.stan --o=/Users/carp/temp2/berman.hpp
Model name=berman_model
Input file=/Users/carp/temp2/berman.stan
Output file=/Users/carp/temp2/berman.hpp

SYNTAX ERROR, MESSAGE(S) FROM PARSER:


ERROR at line 4

2: vector applyTransformations(real x, real p, real param1, real param2, real param3, real param4, real param5){
3: vector[2] temporary
4: if (x>=0)
^
5: vx<- pow(fabs(x),param1);

PARSER EXPECTED: ";"
---------------------------------

That last line's missing in the current RStan!

What's going on is that the parser expects a semicolon (at
the end of the variable declaration for temporary), so it can't
deal with "if" coming next.

- Bob
